Mu itangazo uyu mukobwa yashyize ku rukuta rwe rwa Instagram na Twitter
column2: yatangaje ko azireberera inyungu mu gihe cy’umwaka agiye kumara ari Miss Rwanda wa 2020.

column1: Iri tangazo rivuga ko uyu mukobwa ari we uzikurikiranira inshingano ze nka Miss Rwanda ndetse n’ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’imishinga ye.
Rivuga kandi ko iki kemezo cyafashwe mu rwego rwo kumureka ngo akurikirane umushinga we ujyanye no kurwanya indwara y’agahinda gakabije  mu zindi ndimi izwi  nka Depression.
Gusa avuga ko azakomeza gukorana bya hafi na Rwanda Inspiration Back Up nk’uko abigomba nka Miss Rwanda.

Ishimwe Dieudonné uzwi nka Prince Kid utegura iri rushanwa ubusanzwe ni we wajyaga areberera inyungu z’aba bakobwa baba babaye banyampinga gusa umunyamakuru w’Imvaho Nshya yifuje kumuvugisha kuri iyi ngingo  inshuro zitandukanye  ariko ntiyabasha kwitaba terefone ye ngendanwa.
Prince Kid ukuriye sosiyete ya Rwanda Inspiration Backup itegura Miss Rwanda kuva muri 2014
Uyu mukobwa abaye uwa kabiri ufashe iki kemezo kuko mu 2015 na Kundwa Doriane ariko yabigenje.
Nyuma ye abandi bakobwa batowe barimo Miss Mutesi Jolly
column2: Iradukunda Elsa na Iradukunda Liliane bose bagiye barebererwa inyungu na Rwanda Inspiration Back Up itegura iri rushanwa kuva mu 2014.

column1: Nishimwe Naomie yatowe mu birori byabaye mu ijoro ryo ku wa Gatandatu tariki 22 Gashyantare 2020. Afite imyaka 21 agapima metero 1 na santimetero 70.

Mu itangazo iri tsinda ryasohoye rivuga ko babajwe no gusubika ibitaramo bari bafite mu Bwongereza bakaba babisubitse kubera icyorezo cya Coronavirus.

Iri tsinda ryagombaga gukorera ibitaramo mu Bwongereza mu mpera z’uku kwezi. Aba bahanzi kandi baherutse gusohora indirimbo  “Suzana”  imaze kurebwa n’abarenga miriyoni 5 ku rubuga rwa Youtube.

column1: Abategura iri rushanwa babinyujije ku rukuta rwabo rw’urubuga rwa Twitter batangaje ko bafashe umwanzuro wo gusubika iryo serukiramuco ryari rigiye kuba ku nshuro yaryo ya 6.
Ati “Twafashe umwanzuro wo gusubika iserukiramuco ryo kuri iyi nshuro kubera ikibazo cya Coranavirus ikomeje guhangayikisha Isi yose”.

Iri serukiramuco ryari kuzatangira ku ya 21 rikagera ku ya 24 Werurwe 2020. Igihe rizasubukurirwa kizatangazwa mu gihe ubuyobozi bw’Umujyi wa Kigali buzaba bwakomoreye ibikorwa by’imyidagaduro n’ibitaramo.
Iri serukiramuco ryari rigiye kuba ku nshuro ya Gatandatu ryari kuzerekanwamo firime 12 mu kiciro cya firime ndende nyafurika harimo iyitwa Karani Ngufu yakozwe n’Abanyarwanda.
Mu kiciro cya firime mbarankuru nyafurika hari kuzerekanwa firime 15 harimo iyitwa “The 600: The Soldiers Story” iherutse kwegukana igihembo muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika.
Ikiciro cya firime ngufi nyafurika kirimo firimi 19 harimo iyitwa “I Got My Things and Left” ya Philbert Aimee Mbabazi Sharangabo mu gihe mu kiciro cya firime ngufi zo mu Rwanda harimo firime 12.
Ikiciro cya firime ngufi zo muri Afurika y’u Burasirazuba kigizwe na firime esheshatu
Ikiciro cya Panorama kigizwe na firime eshanu harimo iyitwa “Notre Damme Du Nil” yakozwe na Atiq Rahim ashingiye ku gitabo cy’umunyarwandakazi Scholastique Mukasonga.
Nyuma y’iri serukiramuco hatangwa ibihembo bitandukanye kuri firime zahize izindi mu rwego rwo gushyigikira abakora umwuga wa sinema.

Ku rundi ruhande icyorezo cya Coronavirus gikomeje kuba ikibazo gihangayikishije Isi yose. Ingamba zitandukanye zikomeje gufatwa mu rwego rwo kugabanya umubare w’abandura ndetse ibihugu itarageramo bikomeje kugira amakenga ngo hatagira umuturage n’umwe ufatwa.
U Rwanda rwafashe ingamba zo kongera isuku ahantu hahurira abantu benshi

column3:
Witakenge Jeannot  wakiniye ikipe ya Rayon Sports, APR FC n’ikipe y’igihugu y’u Rwanda akaba  yakomokaga muri RDC,  mu ijoro ryo ku wa Gatanu tariki 24 Mata 2020  yapfuye azize uburwayo yari amaranye iminsi akaba yari arwariye mu bitaro by’i Bukavu (Hôpital Provincial Général de Référence de Bukavu).
Aya makuru yemejwe na mukuru we, Wakenge Kigogo Jolie mu itangazo yashyize ahagaragara amenyesha inshuti z’umuryango ndetse n’aho Witakenga Jeannot   yaciye nk’umukinnyi mu mu makipe atandukanye.
Tariki 27 Mata 2020 ni bwo Witakenge Jeannot    azashyingurwa mu irimbi ry’ahitwa Ruzizi i Bukavu.
Nyakwigendera Witakenge Jeannot wari ufite imyaka 39 y’amavuko  yatangiye kugira uburwayi muri Nyakanga 2019 aho  basanze afite ikibazo cya kanseri mu gifu aho yabazwe agasa n’uworohewe akava mu bitaro. Tariki 11 Mata 2020, Witakenge Jeannot yasubiye mu bitaro  nyuma y’iminsi 6 byavuzwe ko yapfuye ariko umuryango we ukabinyomoza gusa bemeza ko arembye cyane.
Witakenge  wari umukinnyi mwiza wo hagati mu kibuga, yakiniye ikipe ya St Eloi Lupopo, Muungano (RDC), Rayon Sports na APR FC (Rwanda) na  AS Inter Stars (Burundi). Nyuma yabaye umutoza wungirije mu ikipe ya Rayon Sports muri 2017 kugeza 2018  ubu akaba yakinaga mu ikipe y’abakanyujijeho ya VC les Épaves i Bukavu.
